steps.name: Threads heading shows with no threads
steps.goal: If Your data and AI providers is visible, tap Agree and continue. Otherwise only look at the left rail. Do not open anything.
steps.done: The left rail shows the Threads heading with its New button, even though there are no threads yet.

steps.name: New opens a thread beside the rail
steps.goal: Tap the New thread button next to the Threads heading in the left rail. Do not tap New session or the message field.
steps.done: An empty new thread is open in the pane beside the rail.
